summary: Secluded forestry clearing off a sandy track, already used for informal parking.
reasons: Clearing hidden by plantation on all sides
Firm sandy track in, room to turn
No houses or roads in view

best_section.where: The open sandy clearing south-west of the pin, near where a car and trailer are already parked

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by dense plantation rows on both sides with no buildings, roads or paths visible in the imagery; about as hidden as it gets.
drivers.access_and_room: A firm sand/dirt track leads in from the north and opens into a wide clearing with plenty of room to turn a van around.
drivers.traffic: Looks like a forestry access track off Johnston Road; nothing suggests through traffic, and it's well away from any road.
drivers.convention: Not applicable off-road, but a car and what looks like a small trailer or shelter are already parked in the clearing, suggesting others use the spot.

flags: Entry track has a mean grade of about 3.6% with a max of 8.2% further up; the clearing itself is close to flat (around 0.7%)
sun_shade: Mostly open to the sky, with tall plantation trees enclosing the clearing on the east and west sides.
rubbish: None clearly seen; a dark object near the parked car could be a small trailer or shelter, not identifiable from overhead.
cannot_judge: Whether a gate or access restriction exists at the entrance to the plantation track (not visible in this crop)
Whether the parked vehicles indicate active forestry/camping use or are abandoned
